purpose: Resumable checkpoint for the multi-session ClipForge rebuild. A fresh session reads this file (after ARCHITECTURE.md) and knows exactly what is done, what is next, and what to watch out for — without any memory of prior sessions.

rules_for_future_sessions.update_policy: After every meaningful increment you push, update current_phase, the matching phases[] entry, completed_work, next_action, and last_session. Never leave the repo pushed with a stale BUILD_PROGRESS.json.
never_edit: ARCHITECTURE.md decisions (record disagreements in architecture_concerns instead)
the two preserved subsystems' underlying logic except narrowly-scoped bug fixes (see ARCHITECTURE.md §9)

phases.title: Stage 1 — Architecture design, legacy move, handoff artifacts
phases.notes: All pre-existing files moved to _legacy/ with structure preserved. ARCHITECTURE.md, BUILD_PROGRESS.json, NEXT_SESSION_PROMPT.md written at repo root.

phases.title: Schemas + shared validators + job state machine
deliverables: bot/src/plan.js (JS port of the same validator — must agree with schema.py)
pipeline/ status-writer module for jobs/<job_id>/status.json (schema per ARCHITECTURE.md §6.2)
bot/src/jobs.js job state machine read/write helpers (states per ARCHITECTURE.md §6.1)
unit tests proving schema.py and plan.js accept/reject identical documents
phases.notes: Build first. Everything else depends on these contracts. production.json validation rules are in ARCHITECTURE.md §7.3 and are NOT negotiable.

phases.title: Stage B — render pipeline (voiceover, render, reframe, captions, watermark, enhance, compress)
deliverables: pipeline/stage_b/voiceover.py (Edge TTS, curated voice catalog, 24kHz mono PCM contract)
.github/workflows/stage-b.yml (dispatchable by job_id + production_ref; writes status; publishes final.mp4/final.zip to the job release)
phases.notes: Testable end-to-end with a hand-written valid production.json and any sample video — no bot required. Port logic from _legacy/scripts/ (generate_voiceover.py, cut_and_produce.py, cinematic_reframe.py, generate_subtitles_cinematic.py, apply_creator_watermark.py, enhance_scenes.py, compress_final_video.py).

phases.title: Stage A — ingest + analyze (all source kinds EXCEPT the two preserved subsystems)
deliverables: .github/workflows/stage-a.yml (writes status at each step; torrent candidate flow with awaiting_torrent_selection)
phases.notes: Port from _legacy/scripts/ (download_drive.py url/drive parts, magnet_source.py, torrent_source.py, transcribe.py, scene_index.py, build_key_moments.py, event_frames.py, generate_analysis_prompt.py). Telegram channel + relay sources are later phases.

phases.title: Automatic mode — Gemini analysis producing a validated production.json
deliverables: pipeline/plan/automatic.py (Gemini bounded tool-use analysis, multi-key rotation, validated against schemas/production_plan.schema.json)
stage-a.yml automatic branch (automatic_analysis_running state; dispatch Stage B on valid plan)
phases.notes: Port from _legacy/scripts/automatic_analysis.py. Reads GEMINI_API_KEYS Actions secret. Safe failure categories preserved.

phases.title: Bot A — webhook, KV, crypto, home/tasks/settings, New-video wizard, manual handoff, status actions
deliverables: bot/src/index.js (webhook + router, private chats only, webhook-secret auth)
bot/src/github.js (dispatch, files, releases, sealed-secret upload, shadow-clone create/connect)
New-video wizard (mode → source → focus → length → music → confirm)
Manual handoff: Get agent prompt + Upload production.json with validation
phases.notes: UX per ARCHITECTURE.md §8. Single self-editing status message (activeViewId mechanic from _legacy/telegram-bot/src/index.js). Secrets typed in chat are deleted immediately.

phases.title: PRESERVED SUBSYSTEM #2 — direct-video relay (Bot A → group → Bot B → telegram-relay.yml → MTProto download → clone handoff)
deliverables: Bot A direct-video source kind wired into the New-video wizard
phases.notes: Port essentially verbatim from _legacy/telegram-bot/src/relay.js, relay-worker.js, _legacy/scripts/telegram_relay.py, _legacy/.github/workflows/telegram-relay.yml. Do NOT redesign. Security boundaries per ARCHITECTURE.md §9.2: Bot-B/MTProto/RELAY_ENCRYPTION_KEY secrets exist only on the central repo and the bots; clones receive only a temporary prerelease checksummed asset. 1800 MiB cap.

phases.title: PRESERVED SUBSYSTEM #1 — public Telegram channel-link MTProto download (original repo only)
deliverables: pipeline/stage_a/telegram_channel.py (MTProto download incl. bounded parallel transfer + single-connection fallback)
original-repo gate: Stage A re-verifies github.repository == motionssalt/clipforge and fails closed without the MTProto secrets
Bot A intake gate rejecting telegram_channel sources for clones (UX layer only)
phases.notes: Port from _legacy/scripts/download_drive.py Telegram path. Do NOT redesign. Both enforcement layers (missing secrets + server-side repo check) per ARCHITECTURE.md §9.1.

phases.title: Series mode — continuation derivation + manual next-part button
deliverables: pipeline/plan/series.py (next-part derivation from persisted series state)
Stage B continuation step for automatic series
Bot 'Start next part' action for manual series
phases.notes: Port semantics from _legacy/scripts/series_state.py and the manualSeriesContinuation/startNextSeriesPart logic in _legacy/telegram-bot/src/index.js.

phases.title: Publish — Zernio workflow + settings + per-post management
deliverables: Bot Zernio settings screens + per-post actions on completed tasks
phases.notes: Port from _legacy/scripts/zernio_*.py and _legacy/.github/workflows/zernio-publish.yml / zernio-manual-publish.yml. Publishing state lives in status.publishing, never moves a job out of complete.

phases.title: Background workflows — cleanup, deploy-bots, diagnostics
deliverables: .github/workflows/deploy-bots.yml (deploy Bot A + Bot B on bot/** changes)

completed_work.summary: Stage 1 architecture phase. Read the entire legacy codebase. Moved every pre-existing file into _legacy/ preserving internal structure (nothing deleted). Wrote ARCHITECTURE.md (full new design: stage boundaries, state machine, all handoff contracts, bot UX, modes, preserved-subsystem integration), BUILD_PROGRESS.json (this file), NEXT_SESSION_PROMPT.md (reusable handoff prompt with credential placeholders), fresh README.md and .gitignore at root.

next_action: Build the 'contracts_and_schemas' phase exactly as specified in its deliverables list. This is the foundation every other phase imports. Do not start any other phase first.

last_session.final_note: Design complete and pushed. No new-version implementation code exists yet — that is intentional. Start with contracts_and_schemas.
